title: Isolation Level — SERIALIZABLE
description: Demonstrate the SERIALIZABLE isolation level to prevent phantom reads.

data.text: Write a transaction that reads employee salaries and uses SERIALIZABLE isolation level to prevent other transactions from inserting new rows matching the criteria during the read.

data.title: SQL Solution
Explanation
data.text: SERIALIZABLE is the strictest isolation level. It prevents dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, AND phantom reads by holding range locks (key-range locks) on the scanned range. This guarantees the data read cannot change mid-transaction. It reduces concurrency — use only when absolutely necessary.
